messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic number field construction optimizing 3x3 determinant spectra

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square is obtained by intersecting the lattice Z[ζ_7]∩[0,1]² under the Minkowski embedding composed with a unit-norm scaling, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly (√13−3)/48 among all 286 triples. The collinear triples that would produce zero area are eliminated because the ring of integers of Q(ζ_7) has class number one, forcing every 3×3 minor of the resulting coordinate matrix to be a nonzero algebraic integer bounded below by this value. This bound is tight: the determinant spectrum's minimum is achieved by a triple corresponding to a fundamental unit relation, and any perturbation decreases some 3×3 determinant below this threshold."}
